rust_summary: transparent background rendering behind in-game screens (`native_screen_transparent_background`), menu background blur (`native_apply_screen_blur`, `native_menu_blur_radius`) and tiled menu backgrounds (`native_draw_menu_background`, `native_tiled_sprite`).
doc_summary: `native_screen_transparent_background(screen, batch, canceled)` (`Screen.renderTransparentBackground`) runs before drawing the translucent dark background behind in-game screens (inventory, containers, creative, books, signs, editors); set `canceled` to suppress the vanilla dark gradient. `apply_screen_blur()` requests vanilla's menu background blur for this frame, with a per-frame guard so blur applies at most once. `menu_blur_radius()` answers the configured `menuBackgroundBlurriness` option. `draw_menu_background(batch, rect, in_world)` draws the tiled 32x32 menu background across `rect`. `tiled_sprite(batch, sprite, rect, size, argb)` tiles an atlas sprite. Bundles need "hooks": @API:screen_transparent_background@.
